findings.title: Many open notices are old
findings.text: Of 11,550 vacant building notices still open in the snapshot, 3,383 (29%) were issued before 2016; the oldest dates to 2004-11-05. 5,775 (50%) were issued in 2022 or later.
findings.metric: open vacant building notices by year of DateNotice

findings.title: Open notices are geographically concentrated
findings.text: 10 of 279 neighborhoods hold 38% of all open notices (led by Carrollton Ridge with 745), while 65 neighborhoods have none.
findings.metric: open vacant building notices per neighborhood (raw counts)

findings.title: Recorded rehab permits on vacant buildings over time
findings.text: The rehab layer records 12,863 parcels (one record per parcel). By permit issue year, records go from 959 in 2015 to a peak of 1,253 in 2024. 2026 is a partial year.
findings.metric: rehab records by year of DateIssue

findings.title: City demolitions peaked, then fell
findings.text: Completed city demolitions peak at 780 in 2019; the latest full year (2025) records 163.
findings.metric: completed city demolition records by year of DateDemoFinished

findings.title: A rehab permit is not the end of the story
findings.text: Linking on the shared BLOCKLOT parcel ID, 202 of 11,550 open-notice parcels (1.7%) also appear in the rehab layer. In 202 of those cases the rehab permit was issued before the currently open notice (0 on or after it) - the records cannot say whether that rehab was completed. 22 open-notice parcels also have a completed city demolition record.
findings.metric: parcel-level join on BLOCKLOT between open notices, rehab records and demolition records

findings.title: Permits are not buildings
findings.text: 292,806 permit records cover only 90,556 distinct parcels; 42,938 records are flagged as modifications of an earlier permit.
findings.metric: building permit records vs distinct BLOCKLOT values

findings.title: Two snapshots of the open list
findings.text: The DHCD open-notice layer (latest notice 2026-08-25) and the dmxLandPlanning layer (latest notice 2026-09-18) share 11,365 notices. 185 notices appear only in the earlier snapshot and 116 only in the later one. Neither layer carries cancel or abate dates, so closed notices are not observable.
findings.metric: NoticeNum set comparison between FeatureServer/1 and MapServer/37
